connector.name: Sessy - Amazon SES observability
connector.registryDescription: Read-only Amazon SES observability: search events, inspect bounces, pull delivery stats.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.sessy.do over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the marckohlbrugge account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from your Sessy API keys page (https://app.sessy.do/api_keys). Self-hosters: point the URL at your own instance's /mcp endpoint instead of api.sessy.do. Setup: https://sessy.do/docs/mcp
